name: Withering Frost
description: Lay a palm of deep frost on the target's chest so the cold sinks into the lungs and seizes the breath.

name: Seizing Cold
description: Press a grasping cold into an opponent's limbs until they lock in the posture they held.

name: Stilling Veil
description: Draw a deep veil of cold round the body that stills any blow which comes near it.

name: Halting Chill
description: Freeze a spreading curse or taint on an ally in place so that it goes no further and can be drawn out.

name: Glacial Spear
description: Throw a spear of dense ice that pierces armour and freezes the wound it makes.

name: Locking Frost
description: Lock the qi of the target's whole body in frost so that no art can be called for the length of the hold.

name: Hoary Guard
description: Raise a thick hoary guard that stops several heavy strikes in a row.

name: Numbing Wave
description: Send a wave of numbing cold over a group that robs the legs of all feeling.

name: Ice Cage
description: Close a cage of ice round one opponent too thick for any ordinary blow to break.

name: Bone Frost
description: Freeze the marrow of a target with a touch so the cold ignores skin and armour alike.

name: Hushed Passage
description: Dissolve into fine frost and pass through a thin barrier then reform on the other side.

name: Frozen Dominion
description: School move: lay a slow cast cold over a wide ground until every body in it is held still and the guard of each is open.

name: Cessation
description: Declare a hush on a field and freeze everything standing in it to the heart at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Frozen Silence
description: Hold a long cast and loose a stillness that freezes ground and air and qi throughout the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Grave Frost
description: Crush the fingers of a weapon hand in a closing grip of grave cold.

name: Heavy Chill
description: Lay a slow heavy chill on a target until each breath is shorter than the last.

name: Pale Shroud
description: Wrap the body in a pale shroud of frost that dulls every strike upon it.

name: Cold Remedy
description: Freeze and shatter the roots of a curse on an ally and draw the pieces out.

name: Black Ice
description: Cast a dark dense spike of ice that goes through armour and holds fast in the bone.

name: Chain Frost
description: Cast long chains of ice that wrap an opponent from neck to ankle and tighten at each breath.

name: Cold Keeping
description: Hold the breath and pulse of a collapsed ally in a shell of cold for a short window so a healer can start them again.

name: Rending Cold
description: Drive a fist of rending cold into the centre of a guard and freeze the arms behind it.

name: Pinpoint Cold
description: Draw all the warmth from a single point in the target so the cold ignores any shield laid over it.

name: Apex Chill
description: Stop an attack art in the air by chilling its qi until it falls still.

name: Ghost Rime
description: Vanish into a burst of fine rime and reappear in a cloud of rime behind the target.

name: Stilling Sovereign
description: School move: cast the formed core's cold into a seal that stills every foe in sight and shields the caster.

name: Zero Dominion
description: School move: spread near absolute cold from the core across a wide front so every body in it slows to a halt.

name: Last Frost
description: Bring down the deepest frost the core can draw upon a whole battlefield to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Endless Zero
description: Seal a wide region in a cold that does not lift so that all within it stands frozen at the ceiling of the tier.
